about: Hypersoft Technologies Ltd is an India-listed software-development and IT-services group. Its legacy Hyderabad operation offered custom development, consulting and financial/business applications; the present group is materially larger after acquiring Singapore-based NX Global—with Mindgate Solutions in Singapore /USA—and Nexus Innovate—with a USA subsidiary—through FY26 share swaps.
